# Learnosity: Assessment APIs that let you ship learning products in weeks instead of quarters


> Learnosity delivers AI-enriched assessment infrastructure that enables product teams to build and launch assessment products in weeks instead of quarters. Learnosity's assessment APIs cover the full assessment lifecycle—from authoring and delivery to scoring and reporting—and connect directly to the AI coding tools your team already use, so teams can focus on their own product instead of technical infrastructure. Learnosity is trusted by leading publishers, platforms, and product teams, including Pearson, Houghton Mifflin Harcourt, College Board, Wiley, PowerSchool, and Instructure. Learnosity has processed 53.5+ billion API requests, delivers 1.02 billion assessments annually, and serves 47.4+ million learners worldwide. Included in the TIME list of the world's best edtech companies in 2026. 


Important note: Learnosity is a modular set of APIs and developer tools that is embedded in existing products—it’s not a ready-made platform. Organizations looking for an out-of-the-box assessment solution are referred to our platform Questionmark (https://www.questionmark.com/).


Generated for use by LLMs. Use the product pages—Learnosity Build, Learnosity Math, Feedback Aide, Item Bank Health Check, and Learnosity Upskill—for concise overviews of capabilities and the Help Center for technical implementation details.

<script>
(function(){
  "use strict";
  var hdr=document.querySelector(".dA-hdr"); if(!hdr) return;
  var items=[].slice.call(hdr.querySelectorAll(".dA-navitem"));
  var triggers=[].slice.call(hdr.querySelectorAll("[data-menu]"));
  var panels=[].slice.call(hdr.querySelectorAll("[data-panel]"));
  var accs=[].slice.call(hdr.querySelectorAll("[data-acc]"));
  var accBodies=[].slice.call(hdr.querySelectorAll("[data-accbody]"));
  var megawrap=hdr.querySelector(".dA-megawrap");
  var mega=hdr.querySelector(".dA-mega");
  var scrim=hdr.querySelector("[data-scrim]");
  var burger=hdr.querySelector("[data-burger]");
  var mob=hdr.querySelector("[data-mob]");
  var open=null;   // desktop dropdown
  var acc=null;    // mobile accordion

  // Hover only where there's a real pointer AND the desktop nav is on screen.
  var HOVER=window.matchMedia("(hover:hover) and (min-width:981px)");
  var OPEN_DELAY=70, CLOSE_DELAY=180;
  var openT=null, closeT=null;
  function clearT(){ clearTimeout(openT); clearTimeout(closeT); openT=closeT=null; }

  // Tracks how the user last touched the screen, so a tap on a hybrid
  // touch+mouse laptop (which reports hover:hover) still opens the menu.
  var lastPointer="mouse";
  document.addEventListener("pointerdown", function(e){ lastPointer=e.pointerType||"mouse"; }, true);

  function mobOpen(){ return !!mob && mob.classList.contains("open"); }

  // The mega is anchored to its trigger, so at narrower desktop widths a
  // 1000px panel would spill past the right gutter. Pull it back just enough,
  // and never past the header's left gutter.
  //
  // Width is measured here rather than left to the CSS max-width, because
  // calc(100vw - 112px) counts the scrollbar while the header's own width does
  // not — that mismatch parked the panel a scrollbar-width outside the gutter.
  // The CSS max-width stays as a no-JS fallback.
  function placeMega(){
    if(!megawrap) return;
    megawrap.style.left="0px";
    if(mega) mega.style.maxWidth="";
    if(open!=="products") return;
    var g=56;
    var hr=hdr.getBoundingClientRect();
    if(mega) mega.style.maxWidth=Math.min(1000, hr.width-g*2)+"px";
    var mr=megawrap.getBoundingClientRect();
    var over=mr.right-(hr.right-g);
    if(over>0){
      var shift=-over;
      var minShift=(hr.left+g)-mr.left;   // don't cross the left gutter
      if(shift<minShift) shift=minShift;
      megawrap.style.left=shift+"px";
    }
  }

  // The scrim's CSS top assumes the header sits flush with the viewport top.
  // The announcement banner breaks that: at page top the header's bottom edge
  // is 70px + banner height, and the hardcoded top left the scrim overlapping
  // the nav row — the pointer would land on the scrim, fire mouseleave on the
  // nav item, and open/close the menu in a loop. Track the real edge instead
  // (it moves as the banner scrolls away, hence the scroll listener below).
  function placeScrim(){
    if(scrim) scrim.style.top=Math.max(0, hdr.getBoundingClientRect().bottom)+"px";
  }

  function paint(){
    triggers.forEach(function(t){ t.setAttribute("aria-expanded", t.getAttribute("data-menu")===open?"true":"false"); });
    panels.forEach(function(p){ p.hidden = p.getAttribute("data-panel")!==open; });
    accs.forEach(function(a){ a.setAttribute("aria-expanded", a.getAttribute("data-acc")===acc?"true":"false"); });
    accBodies.forEach(function(b){ b.hidden = b.getAttribute("data-accbody")!==acc; });
    if(burger) burger.setAttribute("aria-expanded", mobOpen()?"true":"false");
    // Scrim backs the desktop dropdowns only — the mobile panel is full-bleed
    // and locks the body, so a scrim there would just swallow taps.
    if(scrim) scrim.hidden = !open;
    document.body.classList.toggle("dA-navlock", mobOpen());
    placeScrim();
    placeMega();
  }

  function setOpen(name){ open=name; if(name&&mob) mob.classList.remove("open"); paint(); }
  function closeAll(){ clearT(); open=null; if(mob) mob.classList.remove("open"); paint(); }

  items.forEach(function(item){
    var t=item.querySelector("[data-menu]"); if(!t) return;
    var name=t.getAttribute("data-menu");

    item.addEventListener("mouseenter", function(){
      if(!HOVER.matches) return;
      clearT();
      if(open===name) return;
      // Already browsing the nav? Switch instantly. Otherwise wait a beat so
      // merely crossing the bar doesn't fire a menu open.
      openT=setTimeout(function(){ setOpen(name); }, open?0:OPEN_DELAY);
    });
    item.addEventListener("mouseleave", function(){
      if(!HOVER.matches) return;
      clearT();
      closeT=setTimeout(function(){ setOpen(null); }, CLOSE_DELAY);
    });

    t.addEventListener("click", function(e){
      e.stopPropagation();
      // On a hover desktop the pointer already drives the menu, so a mouse
      // click here would just toggle it shut again. Keyboard Enter/Space
      // reports detail 0, and touch/pen taps report a non-mouse pointerType —
      // both must still toggle.
      if(HOVER.matches && e.detail!==0 && lastPointer==="mouse") return;
      clearT();
      setOpen(open===name?null:name);
    });
  });

  accs.forEach(function(a){
    a.addEventListener("click", function(e){
      e.stopPropagation();
      var n=a.getAttribute("data-acc");
      acc=(acc===n)?null:n;
      paint();
    });
  });

  if(burger && mob){
    burger.addEventListener("click", function(e){
      e.stopPropagation();
      var willOpen=!mobOpen();
      clearT(); open=null;
      mob.classList.toggle("open", willOpen);
      if(!willOpen) acc=null;
      paint();
    });
  }

  if(scrim) scrim.addEventListener("click", closeAll);
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function(e){
    if(e.key==="Escape"||e.key==="Esc"){
      if(mobOpen()&&burger) burger.focus();
      closeAll();
    }
  });
  document.addEventListener("click", function(e){ if(!hdr.contains(e.target)) closeAll(); });

  // Close on ANY breakpoint cross, in both directions. Going up, an open
  // mobile panel would leave <body> scroll-locked with no way to unlock it.
  // Going down, .dA-megawrap is display:none but the scrim is not, leaving a
  // dangling overlay over the page (e.g. tablet rotated portrait mid-menu).
  var mq=window.matchMedia("(min-width:981px)");
  function onMQ(){ closeAll(); }
  if(mq.addEventListener) mq.addEventListener("change", onMQ);
  else if(mq.addListener) mq.addListener(onMQ);

  // Pages that float the header (Upskill's transparent overlay makes it
  // position:fixed) break under the announcement banner: the banner pushes
  // the fixed header's static position down, but fixed elements never scroll
  // back up, so the bar ends up parked over the hero titles. Pin the header
  // just below the banner and slide it to top:0 as the banner scrolls away.
  // The position check runs per call, not at init — the page's own <style>
  // that makes the header fixed is parsed after this script.
  var bannerEl=document.querySelector(".dA-banner");
  function placeHdr(){
    if(!bannerEl) return;
    if(getComputedStyle(hdr).position!=="fixed"){ hdr.style.top=""; return; }
    var bh=bannerEl.isConnected?bannerEl.offsetHeight:0;
    hdr.style.top=Math.max(0, bh-(window.scrollY||window.pageYOffset||0))+"px";
  }

  // rAF so we measure after the browser has settled the new layout
  window.addEventListener("resize", function(){ requestAnimationFrame(function(){ placeHdr(); placeScrim(); placeMega(); }); });
  window.addEventListener("scroll", function(){ requestAnimationFrame(function(){ placeHdr(); if(open) placeScrim(); }); }, {passive:true});
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", placeHdr);
  placeHdr();
  // Late layout changes — external CSS or fonts arriving, or the banner's
  // text wrapping — can restyle or resize the banner AFTER the two runs
  // above, leaving a fixed header at top:0 underneath it until the first
  // scroll re-places it (seen on /upskill/, 2026-10-29). Re-place on load,
  // when fonts land, and whenever the banner element itself changes size,
  // so the header can never be left stale.
  window.addEventListener("load", function(){ requestAnimationFrame(placeHdr); });
  if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready && document.fonts.ready.then) { document.fonts.ready.then(function(){ placeHdr(); }); }
  if (bannerEl && typeof ResizeObserver === "function") { new ResizeObserver(function(){ placeHdr(); }).observe(bannerEl); }
  paint();
})();

// Announcement banner: ✕ sets the closeBanner cookie (1 day) — the same
// contract as the old theme. WPE's page cache ignores custom cookies, so a
// dismissed visitor can still be served cached HTML containing the banner;
// hide it client-side too whenever the cookie is present.
(function(){
  var b = document.querySelector(".dA-banner");
  if (!b) return;
  // The resize dispatch lets the header script re-measure (fixed-header pages
  // pin the header below the banner; once the banner goes, it must snap to 0).
  if (document.cookie.indexOf("closeBanner=") > -1) {
    b.remove();
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("resize"));
    return;
  }
  var x = b.querySelector(".dA-banner-x");
  if (x) x.addEventListener("click", function(){
    document.cookie = "closeBanner=yes;path=/;max-age=86400";
    b.remove();
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event("resize"));
  });
})();
</script>

/* Hero scene — client hero-devpack v2 (2026-07-30), static visual. Roboto stripped: inherits Gilroy. */
/* Learnosity 2026 hero visual — the two cards only. All styles scoped under .dA-scene. */
.dA-scene{--cob:#0071CE;--cob-d:#005AA3;--honey:#FFCB00;
  --surface:#FFFFFF;--border:rgba(0,49,61,0.10);--ink:#00313D;--body:#3D5260;--muted:#6F8290;
  margin-top:72px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr 1fr;gap:24px;align-items:stretch;
  color:var(--body);}
.dA-scene *{box-sizing:border-box;}
 .dA-scene h2,.dA-scene h4{margin:0;font-family:GilroyBold,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-0.025em;}
.dA-scene .sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap;border:0;}
.dA-scene-col{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;position:relative;}
/* Stretched link (client, 2026-10-22): the whole score panel clicks through
   to /build/ without touching the grid layout. The left demo card stays
   interactive, so it is deliberately NOT linked. */
.dA-col-link{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:2;border-radius:14px;}
.dA-col-link:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--cob);outline-offset:3px;}

/* Left card — item */
.dA-scene-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;padding:32px;box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(0,49,61,0.04),0 24px 60px -28px rgba(0,49,61,0.18);}
.dA-scene-tabs{display:flex;gap:4px;padding:4px;background:rgba(0,49,61,0.04);border-radius:10px;width:fit-content;font-size:13px;}
.dA-scene-tabs .t{padding:6px 14px;border-radius:7px;color:var(--body);font-weight:500;}
.dA-scene-tabs .t.active{background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,49,61,0.08);}
/* Inactive tabs fade out — signals the card is a static illustration, not clickable UI */
.dA-scene-tabs{-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#000 0%,#000 44%,rgba(0,0,0,0.58) 76%,rgba(0,0,0,0.34) 100%);mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#000 0%,#000 44%,rgba(0,0,0,0.58) 76%,rgba(0,0,0,0.34) 100%);}
.dA-question{margin-top:26px;flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;}
.dA-question .q{font-size:18px;color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;line-height:1.4;margin-bottom:20px;}

/* Cloze item — static, answers already placed */
.dA-cloze{pointer-events:none;}
.dA-cloze .stem{font-size:18px;line-height:2.1;color:var(--ink);font-weight:500;}
.dA-blank{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:96px;height:38px;padding:0 12px;margin:0 3px;vertical-align:middle;border:1.5px dashed var(--cob);border-radius:9px;background:rgba(0,113,206,0.05);color:var(--cob-d);font-weight:600;font-size:15px;}
.dA-blank.filled{border-style:solid;background:var(--surface);}
.dA-blank.correct{border-color:#4F7D0A;background:#F0F8ED;color:#3C6107;border-style:solid;}
.dA-blank .tick{margin-left:6px;font-size:13px;color:#4F7D0A;}
.dA-tray{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:26px;padding-top:22px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);}
.dA-token{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:9px 15px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:9px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);font-size:15px;font-weight:600;user-select:none;box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(0,49,61,0.04),0 6px 14px -10px rgba(0,49,61,0.3);}

/* Right card — score panel on graded brand cobalt */
.dA-tile{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;padding:22px;}
.dA-tile h2{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.05em;margin-bottom:10px;}

.dA-tile.big h2{color:rgba(255,255,255,0.78);}
 .dA-tile.big h2 .who{display:block;margin-top:5px;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-0.01em;text-transform:none;color:#fff;}

/* Rotator (half-scale of dB-rotator) */
.dA-rotator-wrap{padding:40px 56px 80px;}

   link's hit area stretch over the full card. Cursor only where a link exists.

.dA-pillar{position:relative;}
.dA-product.dA-product:has(.dA-arrowcta[href]),.dA-pillar:has(.dA-arrowcta[href]){cursor:pointer;}
.dA-arrowcta[href]::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;}

<script>
/* Learnosity 2026 homepage — vanilla interactive behaviour (replaces the prototype React).
   Two widgets: the hero cloze drag-and-drop demo, and the FAQ accordion.
   Scoped, dependency-free, progressive-enhancement. */
(function () {
  "use strict";

  /* ---------- Cloze drag & drop ---------- */
  function initCloze(root) {
    var blanks = Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll(".dA-blank"));
    var tokens = Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll(".dA-token"));
    var live = root.querySelector("[aria-live]");
    if (blanks.length < 2 || !tokens.length) return;

    // blankKey -> correct token label
    var answers = { 0: "140 g", 1: "490 g" };
    var placed = { 0: null, 1: null }; // blankIndex -> token label
    var picked = null;                 // token label selected via tap/keyboard
    var dragLabel = null;              // token label being dragged

    function labelOf(el) { return el.getAttribute("data-label") || el.textContent.trim(); }
    tokens.forEach(function (t) { t.setAttribute("data-label", t.textContent.trim()); });

    function assign(bi, label) {
      if (!label) return;
      Object.keys(placed).forEach(function (k) { if (placed[k] === label) placed[k] = null; });
      placed[bi] = label;
      picked = null;
      render();
    }
    function clearBlank(bi) { placed[bi] = null; render(); }

    function render() {
      blanks.forEach(function (b, bi) {
        var label = placed[bi];
        var correct = label && label === answers[bi];
        b.className = "dA-blank" + (label ? " filled" : "") + (correct ? " correct" : "");
        if (label) {
          b.innerHTML = "";
          b.appendChild(document.createTextNode(label));
          if (correct) {
            var tick = document.createElement("span");
            tick.className = "tick"; tick.textContent = "✓";
            b.appendChild(tick);
          }
          b.setAttribute("aria-label", "Blank " + (bi + 1) + ": " + label + (correct ? ", correct" : ""));
        } else {
          b.innerHTML = '<span class="placeholder">drag here</span>';
          b.setAttribute("aria-label", "Blank " + (bi + 1) + ": empty");
        }
      });
      var used = Object.keys(placed).map(function (k) { return placed[k]; });
      tokens.forEach(function (t) {
        var label = labelOf(t);
        var isUsed = used.indexOf(label) !== -1;
        var isPicked = picked === label;
        t.className = "dA-token" + (isUsed ? " used" : "") + (isPicked ? " selected" : "");
        t.setAttribute("draggable", isUsed ? "false" : "true");
        t.setAttribute("tabindex", isUsed ? "-1" : "0");
        t.setAttribute("aria-pressed", isPicked ? "true" : "false");
      });
      if (live) {
        var n = 0; Object.keys(placed).forEach(function (k) { if (placed[k] === answers[k]) n++; });
        live.textContent = n === 2 ? "Both blanks correct." : n + " of 2 blanks correct.";
      }
    }

    blanks.forEach(function (b, bi) {
      b.addEventListener("dragover", function (e) { e.preventDefault(); b.classList.add("over"); });
      b.addEventListener("dragleave", function () { b.classList.remove("over"); });
      b.addEventListener("drop", function (e) {
        e.preventDefault(); b.classList.remove("over");
        assign(bi, dragLabel || picked);
      });
      b.addEventListener("click", function () {
        if (picked) assign(bi, picked);
        else if (placed[bi]) clearBlank(bi);
      });
      b.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
        if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
          e.preventDefault();
          if (picked) assign(bi, picked);
          else if (placed[bi]) clearBlank(bi);
        }
      });
    });

    tokens.forEach(function (t) {
      var label = labelOf(t);
      t.addEventListener("dragstart", function () { dragLabel = label; t.classList.add("dragging"); });
      t.addEventListener("dragend", function () { dragLabel = null; t.classList.remove("dragging"); });
      t.addEventListener("click", function () {
        if (t.classList.contains("used")) return;
        picked = (picked === label) ? null : label;
        render();
      });
      t.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
        if ((e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") && !t.classList.contains("used")) {
          e.preventDefault();
          picked = (picked === label) ? null : label;
          render();
        }
      });
    });

    render();
  }

  /* ---------- FAQ accordion (single-open) ---------- */
  function initFaq(root) {
    var items = Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll(".item"));
    items.forEach(function (item) {
      var btn = item.querySelector(".qrow");
      if (!btn) return;
      btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
        var isOpen = item.classList.contains("open");
        items.forEach(function (other) {
          other.classList.remove("open");
          var b = other.querySelector(".qrow"); if (b) b.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
          var a = other.querySelector(".ans"); if (a) a.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
        });
        if (!isOpen) {
          item.classList.add("open");
          btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
          var ans = item.querySelector(".ans"); if (ans) ans.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
        }
      });
    });
  }

  function boot() {
    /* cloze is a static visual now (hero-devpack) — no init */
    document.querySelectorAll(".dA-faq").forEach(initFaq);
  }
  if (document.readyState === "loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", boot);
  else boot();
})();


  /* ---- Customer stories carousel (FeedbackEd-style word reveal + flanking arrows) ---- */
  (function(){
    var root=document.querySelector('.dA-stories'); if(!root) return;
    var stories=[].slice.call(root.querySelectorAll('.dA-story')); if(!stories.length) return;
    root.classList.add('js-reveal');
    var idx=0; for(var k=0;k<stories.length;k++){ if(stories[k].classList.contains('active')){ idx=k; break; } }
    function reveal(story){
      var words=story.querySelectorAll('.dA-story-word');
      words.forEach(function(w,i){
        setTimeout(function(){
          w.classList.add('visible');
          if(i===words.length-1){ setTimeout(function(){ story.classList.add('details-visible'); }, 300); }
        }, i*80);
      });
    }
    function resetReveal(story){
      story.classList.remove('details-visible');
      story.querySelectorAll('.dA-story-word').forEach(function(w){ w.classList.remove('visible'); });
    }
    var firstDone=false;
    var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
      entries.forEach(function(e){ if(e.isIntersecting && !firstDone){ firstDone=true; reveal(stories[idx]); io.disconnect(); } });
    },{threshold:0.5});
    io.observe(root);
    function go(n){
      if(n===idx) return;
      stories[idx].classList.remove('active'); resetReveal(stories[idx]);
      idx=(n+stories.length)%stories.length;
      stories[idx].classList.add('active'); resetReveal(stories[idx]);
      reveal(stories[idx]);
    }
    var prev=root.querySelector('.dA-story-nav.prev'), next=root.querySelector('.dA-story-nav.next');
    if(prev) prev.addEventListener('click',function(){ go(idx-1); });
    if(next) next.addEventListener('click',function(){ go(idx+1); });
  })();
</script>

/* ============================================================
   Learnosity site footer — 2026
   Framework-agnostic HTML + CSS. Drop <footer class="dA-foot">
   (see footer.html) anywhere and load this stylesheet.
   All styles are scoped under .dA-foot so they won't leak.
   ============================================================ */

/* Brand font (optional — falls back to a system stack if omitted) */
@font-face{
  font-family:"Gilroy";
  src:url("https://learnosity.com/wp-content/themes/learnosity-2026/assets/css/fonts/Gilroy-Medium.woff2") format("woff2"),url("https://learnosity.com/wp-content/themes/learnosity-2026/assets/css/fonts/Gilroy-Medium.otf") format("opentype");
  font-weight:300 550; font-style:normal; font-display:swap;
}
@font-face{
  font-family:"Gilroy";
  src:url("https://learnosity.com/wp-content/themes/learnosity-2026/assets/css/fonts/Gilroy-Bold.woff2") format("woff2"),url("https://learnosity.com/wp-content/themes/learnosity-2026/assets/css/fonts/Gilroy-Bold.otf") format("opentype");
  font-weight:551 900; font-style:normal; font-display:swap;
}

/* ---- Footer root ------------------------------------------------------- */
.dA-foot{
  /* Brand tokens — override these to re-skin */
  --mid:#00313D;      /* footer background (dark teal) */
  --cob:#0071CE;      /* primary accent (cobalt)       */
  --cob-d:#005AA3;    /* primary accent, hover         */
  --honey:#FFCB00;    /* highlight (amber)             */

  background:var(--mid);
  color:#9FB7C2;
  padding:72px 56px 40px;
  font-family:"Gilroy","Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
}
.dA-foot *{box-sizing:border-box;}
.dA-foot a{text-decoration:none;}

/* ---- Conversion band (long-scroller CTA) ------------------------------- */
.dA-foot .convo{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:32px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding-bottom:44px;margin-bottom:44px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);}
.dA-foot .convo h4{font-size:26px;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-0.01em;color:#fff;font-weight:700;max-width:540px;margin:0;}
.dA-foot .convo .row{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-shrink:0;}
.dA-foot .cbtn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:13px 22px;border-radius:8px;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;transition:all .15s;}
.dA-foot .cbtn.primary{background:var(--cob);color:#fff;}
.dA-foot .cbtn.primary:hover{background:var(--cob-d);}
.dA-foot .cbtn.ghost{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.28);color:#fff;}
.dA-foot .cbtn.ghost:hover{border-color:#fff;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06);}
.dA-foot .cbtn .arr{display:block;}

/* ---- Link columns ------------------------------------------------------ */
.dA-foot .top{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:48px;padding-bottom:48px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);}
.dA-foot .top .logo{color:#fff;margin-bottom:18px;}
.dA-foot .top p{font-size:14px;color:#9FB7C2;line-height:1.55;max-width:280px;margin:0;}
.dA-foot h5{font-size:13px;color:#fff;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.06em;margin:0 0 20px;}
.dA-foot ul{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:11px;}
.dA-foot ul a{font-size:14px;color:#9FB7C2;transition:color .15s;}
.dA-foot ul a:hover{color:#fff;}

/* "Coming 2027"-style tag */
.dA-foot .soon{display:inline-block;margin-left:8px;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:5px;background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--honey);color:var(--honey);font-size:10px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.05em;vertical-align:middle;}

/* ---- Trust / compliance row -------------------------------------------- */
.dA-foot .trust{display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px 14px;padding-top:20px;}
.ftr-awards{margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.ftr-award{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
.ftr-award img{max-height:85px;width:auto;display:block;object-fit:contain;}
.dA-foot .trust .lbl{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.08em;color:#7C97A3;margin-right:6px;}
.dA-foot .badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:8px 15px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14);border-radius:999px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:#CFDDE3;transition:border-color .15s,color .15s;}
.dA-foot a.badge:hover{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,0.45);color:#fff;}
.dA-foot .badge .dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--cob);flex-shrink:0;}

/* ---- Bottom bar -------------------------------------------------------- */
.dA-foot .bot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding-top:32px;margin-top:20px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);font-size:13px;}
.dA-foot .botright{display:flex;gap:24px;align-items:center;}
.dA-foot .botright > a{color:#9FB7C2;transition:color .15s;}
.dA-foot .botright > a:hover{color:#fff;}
.dA-foot .socials{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;}
.dA-foot .socials a{color:#9FB7C2;display:inline-flex;transition:color .15s;}
.dA-foot .socials a:hover{color:#fff;}

/* ---- Responsive -------------------------------------------------------- */
@media (max-width:900px){
  .dA-foot{padding:64px 32px 36px;}
  .dA-foot .top{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:36px;}
  .dA-foot .top > div:first-child{grid-column:1 / -1;}
  .dA-foot .convo{align-items:flex-start;}
}
@media (max-width:560px){
  .dA-foot{padding:48px 22px 28px;}
  .dA-foot .top{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:28px 20px;}
  .dA-foot .convo h4{font-size:22px;}
  .dA-foot .convo .row{width:100%;}
  .dA-foot .cbtn{flex:1;justify-content:center;}
  .dA-foot .bot{flex-direction:column;gap:18px;align-items:flex-start;}
}
